teaching_sequence.Observe: Compare a table, factored form, standard form, and vertex form without asserting they are interchangeable evidence.

teaching_sequence.Manipulate: Use proposed factor, vertex, and coefficient controls with equivalent keyboard and text inputs; implementation remains MVE-owned.
teaching_sequence.Explain: Name which representation exposes each feature and reconcile exact substitution totals.

teaching_sequence.Transfer: Select a deterministic family with a different mathematical structure from the source family and record source and target modes explicitly.
teaching_sequence.Verify: Require an independent, hint-free transfer exit with complete exact oracles and independently reconstructible totals; trusted scoring remains backend-owned.
